reason: Episode executed the complete pattern for deploying Inertia SSR to Docker/Compose production: adding the SSR service with healthcheck, configuring the env var, coordinating app/scheduler recreation, and reloading nginx-proxy to avoid stale DNS caching when container IPs change.
A .env edit to add one search var recreated Redis on the main host. Data survived by luck of the anonymous volume; the deploy runbook must say so.
On the live recreate, the SSR health loop gave up after 60s still reporting `starting`; the container became healthy with 0 failing streaks shortly after, so the polling window was too short.
Folded into staging-operations (Inertia SSR service section).
